text: {"lessons":["My account is up overall, but the recent small gains and losses show that progress is uneven; I should not assume the trend will continue.","Selling Stock E at a gain did not prevent later fluctuations in my account, so I should judge each trade by my overall risk and income needs, not by a past winning price.","Holding steady through modest swings has avoided unnecessary trading so far; I should keep monitoring my portfolio and make changes only when they support the stability I need in retirement."]}
